title: Mallard Duck Movement
text:
Lake Constance, on the border of Germany, Switzerland, and Austria, is the home base for the mallards tracked here. Most GPS locations cluster around the lake, while a few ducks travel north into Germany in spring and early summer, returning by late summer.
These findings come from GPS tracking records collected from 2007 to 2017 in the site’s data/mallards.csv dataset. Explore the birds’ routes on the Map, or compare their recorded speeds across months on Seasons.
